method: The page adds up a specialty-coffee cupping form exactly as the scores are entered. Six descriptive attributes - fragrance / aroma, flavor, aftertaste, acidity, body and balance - and the overall score each accept 6.00 to 10.00 in steps of 0.25. The three cup-consistency rows, uniformity, clean cup and sweetness, are entered as a count of cups from 0 to 5 and are worth 2 points per counted cup, so five clean cups score 10 in each row. Defects deduct 2 points for each tainted cup and 4 for each faulty cup, and the two counts may not add up to more than the five cups because a cup carries one defect level. All arithmetic is done in quarter-point units, so no rounding error can move a total across a grade boundary; the total is the six attribute scores plus the overall score plus the cup points minus the defect deduction, out of 100. Grade bands are 90 and above outstanding specialty, 85 to 89.75 excellent specialty, 80 to 84.75 very good specialty, and below 80 not specialty. Decimal commas are accepted, exponent notation is not, and scores not on a 0.25 step, outside 6 to 10, or cup counts that are not whole numbers from 0 to 5 are refused with the exact reason. The page does not taste anything, does not calibrate a cupper and makes no commercial claim: it is ordinary arithmetic on the scores supplied. It runs entirely in the browser with no storage, uploads, accounts or network access.

sources.title: Specialty Coffee Association cupping protocol and cupping form: ten attributes, six descriptive and overall scores marked 6 to 10 in 0.25 steps, uniformity, clean cup and sweetness scored 2 points per cup across five cups, defects deducted 2 points per tainted cup and 4 per faulty cup.
SCA cupping score interpretation: totals are out of 100 and 80 points is the specialty-coffee threshold, with 85 to 89.75 and 90 and above as the excellent and outstanding bands.
Specialty Coffee Association cupping form instructions: a tainted cup carries a defect at the 2-point level and a faulty cup at the 4-point level.
